english.note: Use this when the person’s manner is especially rough, coarse, or uncouth rather than merely impolite.

exampleSentences.english: They shout at people in the street all the time; they’re really rude.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日喺街度大聲鬧人，真係粗魯。

english.note: Use this for a remark or manner that is tactless, rude, or lacking in taste.

exampleSentences.english: It is really crude of you to talk about someone like that in front of so many people.
